ranking_exclusions.basis: player mappings to Pakistan or Pakistan A squads

diagnostics: 63 live chase rows have no verified winner and were excluded.

findings.message: Matches with revised targets/overs are excluded from the primary model unless effective target timing is verified.
Duplicate playing-eleven match/team/player keys exist; rows were retained.
Some playing-eleven rows lack a competition/team/player mapping.

source_evidence.evidence: 6 matches have result text explicitly naming a Super Over; 12 innings groups were checked.
All matches with revised target/overs metadata are excluded because no effective-target delivery timeline is available.
All 23,283 four flags match runs=4 and all 12,811 six flags match runs=6, but no source definition or independent scorecard confirms that `runs` is batter runs.
No explicit total-runs field or documented aggregation for runs/extras1_runs/extras_2_runs.
No extras codebook is supplied; Overstep is only a candidate no-ball mapping, while Penalty and other remain unmapped.
No legal-ball flag or source rule defines the legal-delivery effect of every extras category.
Cannot calculate confirmed bowler-conceded runs without total-run and extras-attribution rules.
214 rows use dismissal_type_id=5; the source has no lookup proving that `Stump` means `Stumped` or defining bowler credit.
12 rows have a dismissed-player ID but no dismissal label; all are not marked as wickets and are not counted by the current dismissal metrics.

super_overs.reason: Match-result text explicitly names a Super Over and ordinary innings 1 and 2 are present; provisional score equality is corroborative only.

revised_conditions.reason: No effective-target delivery or per-delivery scheduled-balls timeline is available; exclude affected matches from the primary model.
